feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from iteration 1 (16 mm footprints, 0.024 m span): the oval finish rate rose from 0.8 to 0.9 and line_loss fell from 0.95 to 0.45, but the s-bend still has line_loss 1.1 with 16 of 20 off-track ends (max_error 0.056, close to the 0.06 m limit), and the slalom is still 0 of 20 with line_loss 1.05. rms_error is low on both (0.017, 0.022), so the tape is leaving the array edge rather than the controller tracking poorly. The Integrator has needed no integration fixes for [2,1,0,-1,-2], kp 4, kd 0.5 or base_speed 1.6: steering_oscillation stayed between 0.16 and 0.36 and there were no controller errors. The wider span reduces the steering signal per unit of lateral error, so I have raised kp to 4.5 in this candidate to compensate. Next race: if line_loss on the s-bend and slalom falls to about 0.5 or below, keep the span and move to lookahead. If line_loss falls but the s-bend still leaves the track with max_error near 0.06, test a shorter lookahead. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4 with the larger kp, the gain is too high for the wider span, so reduce kp rather than widening further.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events on the s-bend and slalom are still above about 0.5 with sensor x = ±0.032, ±0.016, 0 at 16 mm footprints, keep the footprint and widen the span further to x = ±0.040 at 0.020 m pitch (sensor_positions x: 0.04, 0.02, 0.0, -0.02, -0.04). Evidence: iteration 1 cut oval line loss from 0.95 to 0.45 with the 16 mm footprint, and slalom line loss stayed at 1.05 with low rms_error (0.022), so the tape is leaving the array edge.

If line_loss falls below about 0.5 but the s-bend still ends off track with max_error near 0.056 to 0.06, set every sensor y to 0.04 (from 0.06) to test a shorter lookahead. Evidence: iteration 1 s-bend had 16 of 20 off-track ends at max_error 0.056, and steering_oscillation of 0.36 leaves room to test this.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4 on the oval or s-bend after the span change, reduce kp to 4.0 or raise kd to 0.8 before changing geometry. Evidence: iteration 1 oscillation was 0.21 on the oval and 0.36 on the s-bend, and the wider span will raise the steering gain per unit error.
